A26.title: Outcome lens
A26.required_behavior: Then-known and subsequently observed outcomes have different availability rules; neighbor selection remains unchanged.

A27.title: Forecast maturity
A27.required_behavior: No backfilled prospective predictions or grading before maturity; missing/censored outcomes do not become failures.

A28.title: Dependence and N
A28.required_behavior: Selected-neighbor count is not statistical effective N; duplicates and common market days handled and uncertainty exposed.

A35.title: Three product modes
A35.required_behavior: Actual output playback, hypothetical historical analysis and current decision support are unmistakably distinct.

A36.title: Navigation and subjects
A36.required_behavior: Direct links/back/filter/cutoff/source focus restore exact current intent and generation in EN/ZH responsive views.

A37.title: Failure visibility
A37.required_behavior: Current, stale-last-good, unavailable, rights-blocked, pending and valid-empty states do not fabricate freshness.

A38.title: Inspectable match
A38.required_behavior: Show why cases matched, what differed, why others were excluded and which outcomes were unseen at query time.

A45.title: Rights and privacy
A45.required_behavior: Authorize before source reads; no restricted bytes/user state in public caches; original retention versus later disclosure rights separately enforced.
